title: "Chen System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y-x\\
\dot{y} &=& ax-xz+by\\
\dot{z} &=& xy+cz
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.3,b=0.7,c=-0.1$ and initial condition $(-2,-3,0)$.
